items.t: [화성 골드러시] ③ AI 옵티머스가 공장을 걷기 시작했다, 데이터로 돌아가는 머스크의 AI 제국
items.d: ※한 데이터 사이언티스트가 10년 가까운 시간 동안 일론 머스크의 회사들의 데이터를 분석했다. 그러자 서로 무관해 보이던 사업들이 ‘화성’이라는 하나의 설계도 위에서 움직이는 것을 발견했다. 그는 이 현상을 책 ‘화성 골드러시’에서 소개하고 5회에 걸친 기고를 통해 우리나라 산업의 현재와 미래를 점검하고, 함께 활로를 찾으려 한다.데이터를 수집, 전송, 저장, 연산하여 돈으로 바꾸는 머스크의 데이터 생태계, 메모리 강국 한국은 왜 데이터 생태계를 만들지 못하나10월 21일 테슬라가 캘리포니아 프리몬트 공장에서 휴머노이드 로봇 ‘옵티머스’의 생산을 시작했다. 테슬라는 주주 서한에서 이 로봇을 ‘우리가 만든 첫 양산 품질의 로봇’이라고 표현했다. 생산 라인이 들어선 곳은 올해 5월까지 모델 S와 모델 X를 만들

items.t: National security and AI figures urge DOJ to probe what Nvidia knew about chip smuggling
items.d: A letter from 15 national security and AI leaders scrutinized the chipmaker’s knowledge of illegal transfers of its chips to China.
items.fullText: EXCLUSIVE Artificial intelligence Artificial intelligence National security and AI figures urge DOJ to probe what Nvidia knew about chip smuggling A letter from 15 signatories scrutinized the chipmaker’s knowledge of illegal transfers of its chips to China. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 On Tuesday, Nvidia’s board of directors announced that it would establish a committee dedicated to investigating national security and export control compliance. David Paul Morris / Bloomberg via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 18, 2026, 10:00 AM EST By Jared Perlo A group of 15 national security experts and AI policy leaders is urging the Justice Department to investigate what Nvidia knew about the alleged smuggling of its advanced AI chips to China, and whether the company continued doing business with customers after evidence emerged that they were illegally diverting the technology. items.fullText: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities November 15, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean.
